root.label: Kevin Warsh appoints five Federal Reserve task forces

events.label: Kevin Warsh appoints five Federal Reserve task forces

slots.name: number of task forces
slots.sentence: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has appointed five task forces to reconsider how the Fed operates: inflation frameworks, data, productivity and jobs, communications, and balance sheet policy.

slots.name: inflation target
slots.sentence: Warsh has committed to the 2% inflation target, for now, but wants to revisit the broader framework.
